key_insight: Organic semiconductor performance is strongly shaped by weak intermolecular forces and interface-driven supramolecular ordering, which can be leveraged to tune electronic properties.
engineering_relevance: For AI solar-cell and organic photovoltaic design, controlling interfacial assembly offers a practical route to improve charge transport, device efficiency, and predictability.
method: Review recent advances in supramolecular assembly at organic-semiconductor interfaces
Link molecular orientation and translational symmetry breaking to electronic behavior
Survey computer simulation approaches for interface ordering and anisotropy
evidence_signal: The abstract indicates a literature review rather than new experimental datasets, drawing on reported advances across transistors, LEDs, and photovoltaics plus simulation studies.
watch_item: A major implementation concern is that device performance remains difficult to predict from molecular structure alone because disorder and interface effects can dominate.
paper_title: The interplay of interfaces, supramolecular assembly, and electronics in organic semiconductors
